inputs.prompt: Same Claude as <Picture 1>: orange hair, amber eyes, ivory lace veil, orange flower, white dress with orange embroidery and black ribbon, correct gentle adult anime face. Keep the exact upright body posture, lowered shoulders, gently bent elbows and wrists held by short chains under the wooden crossbeam. Her back remains against the central post, her body weight supported by her feet on a hidden ledge. Detailed Japanese gothic 2D anime with fine linework, layered cel shading and painted cathedral architecture. Cool blue stained glass and warm amber candle rim light, preserving copper-orange hair. No 3D doll look, no exaggerated grimace, no distorted joints, no captions, no cuts. Change to a closer framing, face and shoulders dominate the image, head to upper chest, both wrists and the wooden beam partly visible at the side edges. Fixed level camera, no camera movement. Claude looks slightly downward and slightly to screen left toward the offscreen priest below the steps. She inhales, her stern protective expression softens, then pleads quietly 'お父様……その子を逃がして。' First softly addresses him, pauses one breath, then says the rest, lips closing at the end. Natural modest speaking mouth shapes and moist eyes, no gritted teeth, no hysterical crying, no smile, no nodding repeatedly. Her neck stays upright and shoulders relaxed; only slight breath movement. Tiny veil flutter. No flames, no smoke, no wood pile in the close framing.
